ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a ruler is placed together with a set square that includes a $30^\circ$ angle. If $\angle 1 = 24^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle 2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, \\
since $\angle$BEF is an exterior angle of $\triangle AEF$, $\angle 1=24^\circ$, $\angle F=30^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle$BEF=$\angle 1+\angle F=54^\circ$, \\
since AB$\parallel$CD, \\
therefore $\angle 2=\angle$BEF=$\boxed{54^\circ}$.
